Corymbia trachyphloia and/or C. citriodora subsp. variegata may dominate on areas of Pleistocene alluvia. Eucalyptus seeana may be present south of Landsborough and Livistona decora may occur in scattered patches or low densities in the Glenbar SF and Wongi SF areas. column42: Lantana (Lantana camara). This native of Central and South America is an invasive species in Australia. It forms dense thickets that smother native vegetation.
